text: Introduction The international MBA program focuses on the cultivation of student’s macro-administration and decision-making ability, leading talent and internationalized field of vision in order that the new opportunity and challenge from China’s and the world’s further development and might enhance the competitive power of enterprises. Graduates with professional degree and the familiarity with Chinese culture are highly sought after in international or multi-national enterprises. The international MBA program will be mainly conducted in English. More than 30% of the modules will be instructed by highly quailed English-speaking lecturers, while other modules will be instructed by experienced SCUT professors. However, Chinese language and culture lessons will be also arranged during the first academic year of study with purposes that an international student studying in China will be expected to have basic command of the language ability and culture familiarity of the host country. From the second academic year, a few modules will be carefully conducted in both China and English (bilingually) after the students have been equipped with necessary language abilities. Why This Program The MBA program in characteristic of a teaching system having distinctive features and conforming to standards which is beneficial to bringing up the needed personnel of enterprises. A globally carefully chosen teaching staff, including professors who are experienced in practical enterprise operation and always effective use of their latest achievements in scientific research for the teaching practices. A background of science and engineering that makes all staff shape a teaching idea of emphasizing practice. In addition to routine lectures, special-designed seminars, case studies, scenarios simulation, enterprise visiting, content-based forum and team working activities will also be arranged to broaden the thinking and vision of the students. A large number of alumni, i.e. plentiful resources of human talents. Courses Core courses (27 credits) Chinese language, Chinese culture, Crosscultural communication and adaption, Managerial economics, Accounting, Organizational behavior, Financial management, Mathematics, Strategic management. Compulsory courses (10 credits) Marketing management, Human resources management, Culture, ethics and leadership, Operation and logistics management, project management. Elective courses (8 credits) Management information system, Financial statement analysis, International business management, Corporate innovation management, Managerial accounting, Marketing research, Marketing channel management. Others Orientation and seminars (10 times)
